title: Saluer
subtitle: Saying hello with tu and with vous
register: casual (tu) between friends, then polite (vous) with a new neighbour
review: Dialogues and key expressions from the user (greetings_fr.md). English translations, questions and notes by Claude: check them.
intro: Two short scenes. Léa bumps into her friend Tom and says tu; then she meets a new neighbour, Madame Martin, and says vous. Listen for how the greetings change.

lines.text: Salut, Léa ! Ça va bien, merci. Et toi ?

tr.en: Hi, Léa! I'm fine, thanks. And you?

lines.text: Très bien, merci. Tu vas où ?

tr.en: Very well, thanks. Where are you going?

lines.text: Je vais à la boulangerie. Et toi ?

tr.en: I'm going to the bakery. And you?

lines.text: Je vais au travail. Oh, je suis en retard ! À plus tard !

tr.en: I'm going to work. Oh, I'm late! See you later!
OK. Have a good day! See you tomorrow!

sections.title: Scène 2 : Léa rencontre une nouvelle voisine (vous)

lines.text: Bonjour, madame. Je m'appelle Léa. J'habite au numéro 5.

tr.en: Hello. My name is Léa. I live at number 5.

lines.text: Bonjour, Léa. Moi, c'est Madame Martin. Enchantée.

tr.en: Hello, Léa. I'm Mrs Martin. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you. How are you?
Very well, thank you. And you?

lines.text: Bien, merci. Bon, au revoir, madame. Bonne journée !

tr.en: Fine, thanks. Well, goodbye. Have a good day!

notes: Salut ! (tu) = Hi! Bonjour ! (tu and vous) = Hello! Use salut only with people you say tu to.
Ça va ? (tu) = How's it going? Comment allez-vous ? (vous) = How are you? Answer: Ça va bien, merci. Et toi ? / Et vous ?
Je m'appelle Léa = My name is Léa. Moi, c'est Madame Martin = I'm Madame Martin (more relaxed).
Enchanté(e) = Nice to meet you. A woman writes enchantée with an extra e; it sounds the same.
À plus tard ! = See you later! À demain ! = See you tomorrow! Au revoir ! = Goodbye!
Bonne journée ! = Have a good day! The answer: Toi aussi. (tu) / Vous aussi. (vous) = You too.
Bonjour, madame: in French, you add madame or monsieur to be polite, with no name after it.

questions.why: Je vais au travail. Oh, je suis en retard !

questions.q: Why does Léa say vous to Madame Martin?
questions.why: Madame Martin is a new neighbour: you say vous to someone you don't know.
